correctness.rationale: For every inner candidate, the exact supporting-angle inequalities reduce on the high-probability surround-origin event to four nearest left/right neighbors. Their rescaled gaps converge to independent exponentials with rates 1,1,alpha,alpha. The limiting three inequalities are integrated exactly to p(lambda,alpha); two-location Poisson asymptotic independence gives L2 convergence. Off-window limits use deterministic radius monotonicity. The direct hull oracle and independent quadrature corroborate intermediate steps, not the proof of the limit.

value.rationale: The n^-2 distance between concentric sampling layers is a geometrically natural threshold for whether a positive fraction of inner points remain exposed.
